title: upstream: OpenMLS skips §4.7 checks without GCE (confirmed)
description: OpenMLS 0.9.1 AppDataUpdate commit validation implements only part of draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 §4.7 (a component gets either a single remove of existing data, or one or more updates). mimi-mls re-checks every rule in member.rs resolve_app_data_updates (found in mimid-1wgh.4.3). Needs a minimal repro listing exactly which rules OpenMLS misses before reporting. Report upstream only with Mark's explicit per-action OK.
notes:
Upstream check 2026-10-17: NOT REPORTED (no issue/PR on §4.7 validation gaps; related merged PRs #2125, #2092, #2098 don't cover it). Unverified lead: in validate_app_data_update_proposals_and_group_context (public_group/validation.rs on main) the Remove branch returns Ok(()) instead of continue when the commit has no GroupContextExtensions proposal or it has no dictionary — would skip duplicate-remove and remove-plus-update checks for remaining components, and never checks 'remove of nonexistent state'. Needs a minimal repro before any report (Mark's OK required).
